name: deepseek-search
description: Search the web and read pages through DeepSeek's own Search and Fetch APIs. A dependency-free stdio MCP server exposes deepseek_search (ranked results with title, URL, relevance score, publish date, site name and a written summary, optionally with full page text) and deepseek_fetch (one page as Markdown), plus a Skill that teaches the search operators and the search-then-fetch workflow. The API key is read from the DEEPSEEK_API_KEY environment variable, a local config file, or the macOS Keychain; no credential is stored in the package.
